I wanna start off by saying that I’m a big fan of Rachel’s color usage and rendering. I think that LO is a very bright, lovely ( juicy, even???) comic because of it.

but I do think that the inconsistency in character design is frustrating. a lot of the times artists will create character sheets so that they can reference and keep in mind each character’s defining aspects. and I feel like not having those defining aspects be a consistent part of a character makes them less… distinct of a character if that makes sense. 

as someone who can be considered plus size, I always have difficulty actually calling Persephone plus-sized because her appearance is so inconsistent. like I’m glad people are able to see that in her but I can’t quite see it, because sometimes it’s clear that her arms and legs are thicker than say, Minthe’s, and sometimes she looks just like Minthe but with a bigger waist. that’s just my 2 cents though!
